dropped.rule: ablation status of table not checked
not a GeoFM (baseline / task architecture / uncategorised)
paper-internal variant of the introducing paper's own method (D7)
per-class sub-score of a headline result (D5)
regression value outside the metric's domain
metric not on a bounded-points or log-error scale (skill scores etc.)
within-paper duplicate (appendix repeats main text; leaderboard 'best of' repeats s2_main)
recitation of an earlier paper's value
metric twin (one metric per paper x benchmark x protocol x fraction x setting)

offset.rule: highest best-K leave-one-paper-out Spearman among the prespecified specs

K.rule: smallest K not credibly worse than the best (paired bootstrap over sources); K is a floor

CaFFe.sensor: multi SAR (ERS-1/2, Envisat, RADARSAT-1, ALOS PALSAR, TSX, TDX, S1)

strict.grouping: dataset version x protocol x fraction x metric

loose.grouping: dataset x protocol family x fraction x metric (versions pooled within source)

estimable.group: South Africa crop type | frozen | unspecified | miou
